move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer; it sounds like working together on the new series matters beyond this individual order. We value that relationship, recognise the strain our late payments have caused, and will ensure payment as agreed. How can faster, dependable payment and the verified reductions in material and energy costs translate into a more competitive unit price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.06 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
